name: vllm_cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache.py. Gathers per-token K from a paged kv_cache (num_blocks,block_size,num_heads,head_size) fp16 and writes quantized dst_k (fp16) and dst_scale (fp32) in-place; this migration allocates both output buffers inside run() and returns them as a tuple (compared elementwise, exact). block_table (batch,blocks_per_seq=2) int32 in [0,num_blocks) and cu_seq_lens int32 (arange step blocks_per_seq*block_size) are built in gen_inputs; kv_cache is plain random. No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
